requirement:
> `Inspect a known node's outgoing targets for the requested label, making those
> targets available to read_node.`
rationale:
The requirement `requirements.sdk.graph.validation-context.outgoing_edges.mcp.description` has one structural obligation. The `outgoing_edges` MCP tool's description must be: "Inspect a known node's outgoing targets for the requested label, making those targets available to read_node."

`crates/trust-but-verify/src/agent/tools.rs#impl[GraphSession<'_, '_, D>/Conversation]/fn[tools]` builds the tool list. Its `outgoing_edges` entry has a `description` field that matches the required text character for character. That function carries the `{impl}` reference to this requirement. The same entry also defines the tool's parameters from the node ID type and the `D::EdgeLabel` subschema, which fits the "requested label" wording.

I did not assess whether `outgoing_edges` actually makes targets available to `read_node`. That is a runtime behavior, so it is outside this structural check, and the requirement text itself only fixes the description string.

There are no acknowledgments and no structural gaps.
